lines: Quotes from the Technocyte Coda version of Drillbit. For the rest of the Coda, see Zeke, Harddrive, Packet and DJ RoM.
- "The fastest way to become what you hate is thinkin' you're above it. "
- "I just wanna do somethin' worth rememberin'."
- "Any exec who says we're like family is gettin' the side-eye from me. I mean, are we stackin' paper or we playin' house?"
- "Fine cars, fine food, and even finer women. Yeah, it's the good life."
- "If you wanna wild out, that's on you. You won't catch me wreckin' a good thing."
- "Yo, mad respect for DJ. Zeke's got frontman energy, but the quiet ones run things behind the scenes. Always watchin', nothin' to prove."
- "Every night, we're out here throwin' down, wearin' out our bodies. We ain't doin' it for nothin', y'know? It's gotta mean somethin'."
- "See, too many folks waste time tryin' to drag others down to their level. It's embarrassing."
- "When we blew up, people who never even looked my way suddenly acted like we were tight. I dunno how to feel about that."
- "I've seen way too many folks reach the top by takin' credit for somebody else's grind. It ain't right."
- "DJ? DJ listens, man. That's what makes him a real leader."
- "I got faith in us, US - even if nobody else does."
- "Man, success wouldn't mean much if I didn't have my people to share it with."
- "My dude. We gotta have each other's backs. Nobody else will."
- "Yeah, Packet gets all of us feelin' protective."
- "You reflect the people you roll with, that's facts."
- "Youth is cool, but wisdom? Wisdom is gold."
- "Real talk? It ain't the money or the fame I'm after. It's the influence."
- "All that talk you hear about fame bein' like a cult? It ain't that far off."
- "I always had a loud voice, and I ain't ever been shy about usin' it."
- "One thing about pain, it's a real motivator."
- "Man, way I see it, we're all sinners, so we're all in this together."
- "Ain't nothin' like hearin' the crowd sing your words back to you, you know?"
- "There's too much I wanna get done, and no time to waste."
- "Once you get a taste of - hearts - you're hooked."
- "They'll bleed you dry if you let 'em."
- "We're just tryna give our best, every time."
- "I didn't handle fame right at first."
- "You know you made it when strangers got a problem with you."
